notes: Scoped opt-in retention of one observed request hop; acquisition must occur within the existing 1000-hop model window on its owning page or context. Returns a bounded response wait, Option.none on completion without a response, and typed unavailable errors for eviction, foreign targets, release or target closure. Each redirect hop resolves separately. Does not retain response bodies.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Optional browser features do work only when requested, within the owning context or operation.
